info.title: KarryGo Hauling Commerce Mission Internal API

post.summary: Quote a Van/Truck commerce fulfilment route.
post.description: HMAC v2 internal route for vendor-service only. Supports single-pickup and multi-pickup route evidence, readiness/departure windows, handling, dimensions, and optional bounded loading_duration_seconds; creates no booking.

post.summary: Create an already-paid Van/Truck commerce mission.
post.description: Creates one Hauling booking and commerce mission atomically using the customer-approved fee. Persists multi-stop parcel/manifest/handling/loading evidence for the provider operational projection. Same operation_ref with different semantic request conflicts.

503.description: Authority unavailable or kill switch active

get.summary: Read a commerce mission by Vendor operation reference.
Read a credential-free canonical handover observation.
get.description: Vendor-only HMAC v2 route with nonce replay protection. Returns opaque reference, stage, status and monotonic projection version only.

post.summary: Relay a provider-presented pickup OTP or QR.
post.description: Credential is processed transiently by the existing Hauling secure challenge repository and is never returned or projected. Idempotency-Key is required; unknown outcomes use the GET read-back route.
